selection_note: Shortlist 128 is post-hoc: it was the smallest hierarchical setting with exact and reduced score correlations above 0.80 on all three observational corpora. All causal thresholds below were fixed before running this experiment.

hypotheses.C1_hierarchical_direct_effect: The hierarchical route's direct query-effect correlation with oracle is at least 0.85 on both corpora.
hypotheses.C2_hierarchical_downstream_fidelity: Median softmax-Fisher fidelity to the oracle downstream intervention is at least 0.50 on both corpora.
hypotheses.C3_hierarchical_near_flat: The hierarchical median downstream Fisher fidelity is no more than 0.10 below the flat-256 route on either corpus.
hypotheses.C4_hierarchical_beats_fixed: The hierarchical route exceeds the fixed first-16-mode baseline by at least 0.20 median downstream Fisher fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.C5_causal_ood_stability: Hierarchical direct correlation and median downstream Fisher fidelity each change by no more than 0.10 from FineWeb to WikiText.
